description: Connects an entry to a visit in the person's location history.

main.description: Connects an entry to a visit in the person's location history, so the entry appears with that visit even when its time or location alone wouldn't put it there. Only the owner sees it.

evidenceId.description: The visit, named the same way as an app.logdate.place.correction's evidenceId: by the id of one of its location samples, or by the record key of a visit the person added.

createdAt.description: When the entry was connected, when known.
